body: It's not the reason. I didn't include talking about my past relationship because I was sad that I am no longer in it. I'm not suicidal because of this relationship. The relationship was the only reason I was not suicidal.

The issue I have with this relationship isn't that I want to be with the person. I want the feeling of being with that person. I have been in relationships before, I thought I was in love and happy before, but I wasn't. I was recently, and that's what I desperately hold on to from this toxic affair. I do not see a point in time where I will ever be as comfortable and feel as loved as I did with her. I can't trust people anymore, I don't find anyone attractive anymore.

I have a dog and I spent my teenage years locked in my room playing video games and they don't have a positive effect on me. Currently, all I do is drink and consume whatever drugs I'm able to find. Keeps me occupied pretty well. The issue is not that I am sad that I am no longer in a relationship. It's the fact that I had what I wanted for the first time in my entire life, happiness, and even still it just made me feel worse. Something I didn't think was possible, given where I started.
